_readme: Editorial pass over the generated stories. Principle: keep the researcher's
SWBST 'correct' line verbatim and bend the distractors to match its register
(subject form, infinitive form, length). 'correct' is only rewritten when it
was too long to read on a moving race card (>12 words), and then only by
trimming, never by changing meaning. Where a page question is not
SWBST-shaped, distractors are rewritten to fit the SLOT rather than the
question, since the race card is answering the slot.
